text:
Alana: Quick sync 1: recognition kiosk for the Summer All-Hands is next Fri. need to finalize float, approvals, and cross-border gift card process.
Priya: Ill staff the morning shift but we need clarity on international cards - some folks in EMEA/APAC cant redeem certain vendors.
Jonas: Agreed. budget wise we have an EOY pool and a separate events budget. which one covers spot awards at the kiosk?
Alana: Events budget covers physical swag and admin. spot-awards (monetary) come from the recognition pool. finance confirmed yesterday.
Mei: For international folks, can we offer a USD digital card OR a local-store voucher? we should avoid tax surprises.
Carlos: Finance-bot says: "Monetary awards over $100 must be reported for payroll tax in some countries. See policy: https://intra.redwood/comp/awards."
finance-bot: Reminder: set "award_country" field when logging awards to ensure correct tax handling.
Priya: Ok, so we'll set a kiosk rule: default $50 e-gift or manager can nominate up to $200 with director approval.
Jonas: Will the kiosk accept nominations without manager sign-off, and queue them for approval? wifi might be spotty in the ballroom.
Alana: We'll take physical nomination cards at the kiosk and a volunteer does batch entry later. offline spreadsheet template attached in the event doc.
Mei: Can we provide prepaid local gift vouchers for EMEA/APAC? that avoids bank transfer delays. procurement ok with bulk voucher purchases?
Carlos: Procurement says yes for standard vendors, but we need vendor codes. I'll pull the approved vendor list and post here by Wed.
Priya: Inventory checks: shirts (M/L only), stickers, enamel pins 15 tokens, 90 printed nominee cards, 60 pre-printed e-gift codes (USD).
Alana: Action: Priya to bring lockable cash box with petty-cash form. Jonas to bring barcode labels + QR sheet for inventory scanning. Mei to prepare sealed envelopes for private awards.
peopleops-bot: Event checklist update: /docs/events/summer-all-hands/recognition-kiosk-v2.pdf created.
Jonas: For approvals workflow: physical sticker "Approved" (manager + date) for anything >$150. we'll keep a bindersheet of approvals at the kiosk.
Priya: I'll make a small A6 manager-approval sticker sheet (yes/no/name/date).
Carlos: Post-event reconciliation: submit receipts + signed approval sheet to finance within 7 days. finance-bot will auto-audit and flag mismatches.
Mei: Accessibility note: offer a private sign-up slot and a low-sensory table option. also include translation cards (EN/FR/ES).
Alana: Love the inclusivity bits. final volunteers list: 
- 901:30  Priya + Jonas
- 11:30 1:30  Alana + Mei
- 1:30 3:30  Jonathan (floor) + backup
Alana: Last thing: can someone from comms make a small FAQ card for the kiosk: "What counts as a spot award? How long to expect e-gift delivery?"
Priya: I'll draft the FAQ and ping comms.
Alana: Thanks all. locking volunteer roster at 5pm tomorrow. will DM the vendor list when Carlos posts it.
Carlos: will post vendor list Wed noon.
peopleops-bot: Note saved: kiosk volunteer roster locked 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z.
